reason: S1 adds callable behavior for the public `is_number` and `tie` APIs and changes `padded_string` construction semantics, but H0 only calls `parser.parse`, `element::at_pointer`, and `element::get_string`. It therefore cannot exercise the new numeric classification, typed extraction/error assignment, or constructor buffer-initialization behavior. These behaviors were added or materially changed from S0, so the gap is commit-induced rather than merely historical.
evidence: `simdjson_result<dom::element>::is_number()` is newly declared and implemented as `!error() && first.is_number()`.
`element::is_number()` is newly implemented with distinct `is_int64()`, `is_uint64()`, and `is_double()` paths.
`element::tie(T &value, error_code &error) &&` is newly implemented as `error = get<T>(value)`.
Four `padded_string` constructors stop writing a trailing `\0`; the `std::string_view` constructor also changes its copy guard from `data_ptr != nullptr` to `sv_.size()`.

H0 invokes only `parser.parse(fd.json_doc.data(), fd.json_doc.size())`, `root.at_pointer(fd.json_pointer)`, and `leaf.get_string()`; it never constructs a `padded_string` or calls `is_number` or `tie`.
The affected implementations are absent or behaviorally different in S0, establishing that this commit introduced or aggravated the uncovered surface.
recommended_action: Extend the harness or add a companion harness that constructs `padded_string` values from fuzz-controlled lengths and source forms, and invokes both `element::is_number`/`simdjson_result<dom::element>::is_number` and rvalue `element::tie` across fuzz-selected target types while checking the returned `error_code`.
